title: The Word of God
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names ways of handling the Bible with respect.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the Bible is God's book.
floor.question: Whose book is the Bible?

steps: Say why the Bible is special.
Show how to hold and open it.

board.do: Draw a child sitting on a book.

board.say: Is this how we treat the Bible?

board.do: Wait for the child to say no.
List five ways to handle the Bible.

misconceptions.ask: Can you draw in the Bible?
misconceptions.repair: Show a clean Bible and a scribbled book. Agree how we treat God's book.

misconceptions.ask: Where should you keep the Bible?
misconceptions.repair: Choose a special shelf in class for the Bible.

misconceptions.ask: What should your hands be like when you hold the Bible?
Can you throw the Bible to your friend?
misconceptions.repair: Practise passing the Bible with two hands.

checks.question: Name a way to handle the Bible.
Can you write in the Bible?

skills.key_step: The child names the two divisions of the Bible and the first two New Testament books.

floor.question: How do you hold the Bible?

board.do: Draw a Bible with two parts.
Wait for the child to say the New Testament.
Write Matthew, Mark at its start.

misconceptions.ask: How many divisions does the Bible have?
misconceptions.repair: Show a Bible with a ribbon between the two parts.

misconceptions.ask: What is the first book of the New Testament?
misconceptions.repair: Open at the ribbon: the New Testament starts with Matthew.

listen_for: A newer copy of the Bible
misconceptions.repair: Show both parts in one Bible.

misconceptions.ask: Which comes first: Matthew or Mark?

checks.question: Name the two divisions of the Bible.
Name the first book of the New Testament.
